required_edits: Make the entrypoint contract consistent throughout: `pylae-verify-bootstrap` is the sole supported user-facing entrypoint; direct invocation of the raw launcher or `node pylae` is unsupported.

Correct the boot-order claim to state that the static bootstrap, static launcher, and static sandbox-builder all execute before the authenticated root; the intended guarantee is that no dynamic Node/interpreter/library byte executes before that root.

Remove the claim that the bootstrap’s self-installed filter already prevents an authentic-but-defective bootstrap from listening. Explicitly bound the guarantee: the statically inspected pre-filter `_start` prologue is the trusted, qualification-proven boundary, while kernel enforcement covers all bootstrap code after filter installation and every descendant—or add an earlier independent kernel enforcer.
hard_stops: The exact plan contains contradictory and overstated claims at the PD-001 trust boundary: it names both the bootstrap and native launcher as the sole supported entrypoint, says only the sandbox-builder runs before the authenticated root despite the bootstrap and launcher doing so, and claims the bootstrap’s own filter protects an authentic-but-defective bootstrap before that filter has been installed.
rationale: I recomputed the disk candidate as sha256:b154a6e676f32e515233a2ed41a98c1ce46c0c42a0ae0fcd26bb56e64a46cdcd and confirmed its bytes match reviewed head 0da6f4b6a4b42981b8d63d103ea38f3764a63e8d. The two-phase Phase-A/deferred and Phase-B/atomic transition coherently implements the DISCOVERY-001 ruling. I explicitly ratify SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM and product-1-oq-e6-determinism-deferral because normative-oracle enrollment remains blocked until the declarative evaluator passes its hard merge gate. I likewise ratify SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS and product-1-oq-pd001-nolistener-completeness as bounded exhaustive-audit work with fail-closed enforcement and detection. Those spikes are not the blocker. The remaining bootstrap statements are present-tense contradictions and a factual overclaim in the first-executed TCB boundary, so the immutable plan cannot be implemented AS-IS without choosing which entrypoint, boot order, and pre-filter guarantee govern.
